findings.observation: SUMMARY.md states a counterpoise-corrected binding energy of the methane–water complex at PBE/def2-SVP with a repulsive value of 5.52 kcal/mol, while metadata.yml specifies the objective and method as PBE0/def2-SVP. results.json reports binding_energy = -5.52 kcal/mol (attractive). This is an internal contradiction in both the level of theory (PBE vs PBE0) and the sign/interpretation of the binding energy (repulsive +5.52 vs stored -5.52).

metadata.yml declares `exclusions: []` and SUMMARY.md claims that all runs are reported and none were excluded, but there is no direct evidence or listing of runs/logs to substantiate this. Required evidence for exclusions/completeness is not present beyond bare assertions, so compliance cannot be inferred.
